architectureOverview.providersSupported: Free, freeTier, oauth, apikey, webCookie categories (see providers.js)

ttsCore.noAuthProviders: direct handleTtsCore call, error response on failure

patterns.providerCredentials: getProviderCredentials filters excluded/locked accounts; returns null/allRateLimited; fallback loop in chat/stT handlers
patterns.modelRouting: parseModel -> getModelInfo -> combo detection -> handleComboChat or handleSingleModel
patterns.sseStreaming: handleChatCore try/catch around executor.execute(); token refresh on 401/403; parseUpstreamError for provider errors; streaming vs non-streaming branches

errorHandlingPatterns.errorBudgetPhilosophy: implicit through SLO targets; automation over heroics; manual intervention only on sustained budget consumption

metricsAvailable.usageStats: getUsageStats() — total requests, per-provider/model/account breakdowns, cost, tokens from SQLite
metricsAvailable.errorProviderTracking: global._lastErrorProvider — last provider with error, 10s window timestamp
metricsAvailable.recentRing: 50 most recent usage entries via getRecentLogs()

observability.tracesAvailable: Limited: request ID correlation via sessionSeed→reqTag; unified '▶' log line; '⚙' token saver summary; pending request tracking

goldenSignals.latency: partial — console log lines only, no aggregated metrics
goldenSignals.traffic: good — getUsageStats().totalRequests, per-endpoint counts, recent ring buffer
goldenSignals.errors: good — lastErrorProvider, usage DB status fields, error log lines
goldenSignals.saturation: limited — pending request counts, active account tracking

recommendedAdditions: structured JSON logs with request ID, model, provider, status, latency
SLO dashboard with error budget tracking
alert on error rate spikes (>5% or >2x baseline)

currentMechanisms.modelLock_DB_keys: markAccountUnavailable locks failed accounts/models; clearAccountError clears on success — high effectiveness
currentMechanisms.stickyRoundRobin: consecutiveUseCount per account, reset on success or after limit — high effectiveness
currentMechanisms.antigravityQuotaCache: lazy-loaded per-model quota; skip exhausted accounts until resetAt — high effectiveness
currentMechanisms.errorRules: text/status-based cooldown assignment in errorConfig.js — medium effectiveness
currentMechanisms.fusionQuorum: collectPanel with minPanel + stragglerGraceMs + hardTimeout — medium effectiveness

gaps: no circuit breaker for consistently failing providers
no request-level latency SLO tracked in metrics
in-memory state volatility on process restart
recommended: circuit breaker pattern per provider with closure threshold
health check endpoint /health returning SSE status, pending count, error budget, active accounts
persist in-memory state to DB on shutdown

alertThresholds.critical: error rate > 5% in 5min OR error budget < 10% — page on-call, block deploys — immediate
alertThresholds.warning: error rate > 2% in 30min OR error budget < 25% — notify on-call — 5min delay
alertThresholds.info: pending requests > 100 OR active accounts < 2 for any provider — dashboard alert — 15min delay

currentSLIGaps.latencyDistribution: console logs only, no histogram — needs implementation

currentFailureInjectionPoints: concurrent request surge (no explicit limit, pending gauge available)
model routing failure via combo fallback loop
translator pipeline break with corrupt request body (RTK fail-open)
API key revocation via isValidApiKey check
recommendedExperiments: account kill switch: mark all accounts unavailable, verify fallback to 503
latency spike: inject 5s delay in executor, verify stall timeout handling
translator corruption: malformed request bodies, verify RTK fail-open (null, body untouched)
provider timeout: block upstream 30s, verify circuit breaker / fallback
combo model exhaustion: deplete all models, verify 503 with retryAfter
fusion judge timeout: hang judge model, verify stragglerGraceMs + hardTimeout
chaosEngineering.toolingRecommendations: scripted failure injection via API calls for this Node.js deployment; measure MTTR, fallback success rate, error budget impact

incidentResponse.workflow: detection → triage (check lastErrorProvider, getUsageStats, getActiveRequests) → assessment (provider/broad/translator/deployment) → action (exclude accounts, rollback, escalate) → post-incident (post-mortem, error rule update, toil automation)
incidentResponse.runbookTemplates: provider-wide-failure and SSE-streaming-degradation templates provided in ADR

recommendations.sloSLIPriority: HIGH — implement Prometheus metrics, define 3-5 core SLOs, set error budget alerts, deploy SLO dashboard
recommendations.chaosEngineeringPriority: MEDIUM — create failure injection scripts, test stream stall, validate RTK fail-open, design combo exhaustion experiments
recommendations.incidentResponsePriority: HIGH — create health check endpoint, write runbook templates, establish severity mapping, set up post-mortem process
recommendations.observabilityGapsPriority: HIGH — structured JSON logs, Prometheus metrics, distributed tracing, persist in-memory state, health check endpoint, circuit breakers
recommendations.errorHandlingImprovementsPriority: MEDIUM — circuit breaker per provider, configurable token refresh attempts, max retry per model, deployment SLO validation gate, quarterly error rule audit
